verdict.rationale: HubSpot's marketing page says its AI can rewrite nurture email copy for each contact using CRM data, so the platform has a documented AI email-copy capability. Nothing shows it drafting from a brief, generating subject lines, or working inside the email composer; the editor docs only describe setting subject lines manually. missing for 10: AI subject-line generation, drafting email copy from a brief, evidence the AI assistant is available inside the email composer, first-party how-to docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer

citations.quote: Rewrite every nurture email for the specific contact receiving it, using their CRM data, behavior, and live company research.
